messages:
Zoe: Quick kickoff for NimbusCloud x Redwood mini benchmark + demo + marketplace blurb. Target: 30m live demo + 1 short benchmark post + marketplace listing. Proposed date: 2026-11-02 10:00am PT.

Ken: Sounds good. Audience = infra + platform engs. Lead with reproducible perf delta and a short "how we measured" note.

Asha: Legal heads-up: partner only ok with percent deltas and a short methods caption. No raw p95 numbers. I can redact CSVs.

Tom: Routing/tracking: registration -> HubSpot form. SFDC queue = "Partners/NimbusCloud". Use exact UTM: `?utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=nimbus-rw-nov02`. Form fields: email, company, role, consent.

OpsBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/nimbus-rw-nov02. Recordings auto-upload to gdrive/marketing/partners/nimbus-nov02.

Zoe: Panel: Zoe (host), Nimbus infra lead, Redwood infra engineer, and 1 customer if partner clears legal. Keep slides to 6. Agenda: 5m intros, 15m demo, 6m benchmark highlights, 4m Q&A.

Ken: For the benchmark blog I'll draft a short reproducibility snippet and attach a repo. CTA: "Run the mini-benchmark" + "Request a demo". Draft by Mon EOD.

Asha: I'll upload the redacted percent-only chart to gdrive/partners/nimbus/benchmarks_pct.csv and include the disclosure line: "Results are percent comparisons from internal testbed; see appendix for steps."

Tom: SFDC routing rule: if email domain ends with @nimbuscloud.com -> assign to Nimbus AE, else PartnerOps. Tag leads with campaign=nimbus-rw-nov02 and lead_source=partner_webinar.

Ken: Repro snippet for the blog (short):
```bash
# quick reproduce (local)
git clone https://github.com/redwood/repro-nimbus.git
cd repro-nimbus
./run.sh --model redwood/opt-small --seq 256 --iters 500
```

Zoe: Action items: Ken draft blog + landing copy (Mon), Asha upload redacted CSV + methods (Thu), Tom configure HubSpot + SFDC mapping (Wed). Quick rehearsal Nov 1 9:00am PT. Ping in thread for blockers.

Tom: Got it. I'll post SFDC mapping doc here when live. :white_check_mark:

Zoe: Thanks team. :rocket:
